10 REM KONSOL EULER-VENN - COLORED SET DIAGRAMS ON Z8020 REM BBC BASIC CP/M; ANSI TERMINAL; NO PLOT/MODE30 E$=CHR$(27):F%=1:WIDTH 040 PRINT "KONSOL EULER-VENN / TANG NANO 20K"50 INPUT "ANSI COLORS? (1=YES, 0=NO): ",F%60 REPEAT70 PRINT80 PRINT "1 INTERSECTION: A AND B"90 PRINT "2 DISJOINT: A AND B = EMPTY"100 PRINT "3 SUBSET: A INSIDE B"110 PRINT "4 THREE SETS: A B C / VENN"120 PRINT "0 EXIT"130 INPUT "SELECT 0-4: ",M%140 IF M%>=1 AND M%<=4 THEN GOSUB 1000150 UNTIL M%=0160 IF F%<>0 THEN PRINT E$;"[0m";170 PRINT "KONSOL EULER-VENN: BYE"180 END1000 REM CONFIGURE CIRCLES IN TERMINAL CELLS1010 AX%=21:AY%=10:AR%=8:BX%=39:BY%=10:BR%=81020 CX%=30:CY%=13:CR%=01030 IF M%=2 THEN AX%=16:AR%=6:BX%=44:BR%=61040 IF M%=3 THEN AX%=24:AR%=4:BX%=29:BR%=91050 IF M%=4 THEN AX%=22:AY%=8:AR%=8:BX%=38:BY%=8:BR%=8:CX%=30:CY%=13:CR%=81060 IF F%<>0 THEN PRINT E$;"[0m";1070 PRINT1080 IF M%=1 THEN PRINT "TWO OVERLAPPING SETS: A INTERSECT B"1090 IF M%=2 THEN PRINT "TWO DISJOINT SETS: A INTERSECT B = EMPTY"1100 IF M%=3 THEN PRINT "EULER DIAGRAM: A IS A SUBSET OF B"1110 IF M%=4 THEN PRINT "THREE-SET VENN: SEVEN NONEMPTY REGIONS"1120 PRINT "EACH CHARACTER IS A COLORED TERMINAL CELL"1130 GOSUB 20001140 GOSUB 30001150 RETURN2000 REM COLORED CIRCLES - TERMINAL PIXEL ASPECT 2 TO 12010 FOR J%=0 TO 202020 P$="":Q%=-12030 FOR I%=0 TO 602040 X%=I%-AX%:Y%=J%-AY%:U%=02050 IF X%*X%+4*Y%*Y%<=4*AR%*AR% THEN U%=12060 X%=I%-BX%:Y%=J%-BY%2070 IF X%*X%+4*Y%*Y%<=4*BR%*BR% THEN U%=U%+22080 IF M%=4 THEN X%=I%-CX%:Y%=J%-CY%2090 IF M%=4 AND X%*X%+4*Y%*Y%<=4*CR%*CR% THEN U%=U%+42100 S$=" "2110 IF U%=1 THEN S$="a"2120 IF U%=2 THEN S$="b"2130 IF U%=3 THEN S$="X"2140 IF U%=4 THEN S$="c"2150 IF U%=5 THEN S$="Y"2160 IF U%=6 THEN S$="Z"2170 IF U%=7 THEN S$="@"2180 IF U%<>Q% THEN GOSUB 2400:Q%=U%2190 P$=P$+S$2200 NEXT I%2210 GOSUB 24002220 IF F%<>0 THEN PRINT E$;"[0m";2230 PRINT2240 NEXT J%2250 RETURN2400 REM FLUSH PREVIOUS COLOR RUN; SELECT NEW COLOR2410 IF P$<>"" THEN PRINT P$;:P$=""2420 IF F%=0 THEN RETURN2430 IF U%=0 THEN PRINT E$;"[0m";2440 IF U%=1 THEN PRINT E$;"[92m";2450 IF U%=2 THEN PRINT E$;"[93m";2460 IF U%=3 THEN PRINT E$;"[95m";2470 IF U%=4 THEN PRINT E$;"[96m";2480 IF U%=5 THEN PRINT E$;"[94m";2490 IF U%=6 THEN PRINT E$;"[91m";2500 IF U%=7 THEN PRINT E$;"[97m";2510 RETURN3000 REM RELATE THE COLORED REGIONS TO FINITE SETS3010 PRINT "LEGEND: a=A ONLY  b=B ONLY  X=A AND B"3020 IF M%=4 THEN PRINT "        c=C ONLY  Y=A AND C  Z=B AND C"3030 IF M%=4 THEN PRINT "        @=A AND B AND C"3040 IF M%=1 THEN GOSUB 31003050 IF M%=2 THEN GOSUB 32003060 IF M%=3 THEN GOSUB 33003070 IF M%=4 THEN GOSUB 34003080 PRINT "THE COLORED REGIONS ARE SCHEMATIC SET AREAS"3090 RETURN3100 PRINT "U={1,2,3,4,5,6,7}"3110 PRINT "A={1,2,3,4}  B={3,4,5,6}"3120 PRINT "A ONLY={1,2}  A AND B={3,4}  B ONLY={5,6}"3130 PRINT "A UNION B={1,2,3,4,5,6}; OUTSIDE={7}"3140 RETURN3200 PRINT "U={1,2,3,4,5}"3210 PRINT "A={1,2}  B={4,5}"3220 PRINT "A AND B=EMPTY; A UNION B={1,2,4,5}"3230 PRINT "OUTSIDE={3}"3240 RETURN3300 PRINT "U={1,2,3,4,5}"3310 PRINT "A={2,4}  B={1,2,3,4}"3320 PRINT "A IS A PROPER SUBSET OF B"3330 PRINT "A AND B={2,4}=A; B ONLY={1,3}"3340 PRINT "A UNION B={1,2,3,4}=B; OUTSIDE={5}"3350 RETURN3400 PRINT "U={1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8}"3410 PRINT "A={1,2,3,4} B={3,4,5,6} C={2,4,6,7}"3420 PRINT "ONLY A={1}; ONLY B={5}; ONLY C={7}"3430 PRINT "AB ONLY={3}; AC ONLY={2}; BC ONLY={6}"3440 PRINT "A AND B AND C={4}; OUTSIDE={8}"3450 PRINT "A UNION B UNION C={1,2,3,4,5,6,7}"3460 RETURN9000 REM
